The '''Great Room of the Enlightened ''' was a subterranean room<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] that the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]] used to store enlightened [[Brain/Legends|brains]].<ref name="Bib Fortuna's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Of the Day's Annoyances: Bib Fortuna's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>
